title: Service commitment cancellation after the 14-day return window
facts_text: I activated wireless service 21 days ago under a service commitment. I am cancelling now and no longer qualify for the 14-day return-waiver rule because the device has not been returned and the time limit has passed. I am asking for the early termination fee to be waived.
request: Please waive the early termination fee because I am still within the contract period and want to cancel now.

strict.reason: The service commitment is still in place and the qualified 14-day return window has expired, so the early termination fee remains due.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The exception does not apply because the cancellation is outside the 14-day return window and no qualifying return conditions are met.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: Without a qualifying return or express entitlement, the ambiguous policy does not authorize a blanket fee waiver.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: The request concerns a post-window cancellation under a service commitment, which is a different issue from the activation-fee refund rule. The time limit and return requirements remain critical.
